headline: Metagenome-mined RNA-guided nucleases with broad PAMs; genome-wide off-target profiling
label: Rna Guided Nuclease Tools
summary: Structure-led metagenome search and genome-wide off-target profiling now address both nuclease discovery and specificity assessment.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational work on RNA-guided nucleases across two preprints. A structure-led search of the metagenome yields compact nucleases with broad PAM diversity, with editing validated in eukaryotic cells. SpacerScope provides genome-wide off-target profiling for RNA-guided nucleases without prior candidate-site bias, using binary vectorization and indel-aware validation, and reports recovery of all 6,142 CIRCLE-seq sites. What is new is pairing PAM-diverse nuclease discovery with off-target evaluation that does not rely on candidate-site priors. A third preprint, a transformer model for synonymous codon selection, is a separate computational study and does not address nucleases.
